text:
The bowl is stainless steel, about 20 cm across at the rim. It holds shredded carrot and about 8 grape tomatoes.

Shredded carrot: roughly 50-60 g. Each grape tomato is about 10 g, so 8 tomatoes come to about 80 g. That makes the total about 135 g.

Energy: carrot at about 41 kcal per 100 g gives about 23 kcal. Tomatoes at about 18 kcal per 100 g give about 14 kcal. Together that is roughly 40 kcal, and I'll round up slightly to 45 in case there is a little dressing or oil.

{"kcal": 45, "mass_g": 135}
